owner_calls.question: The record says Leonard 'welcomes Bruce into his home' before tipping off the army. The dinner and fireside scenes where Leonard hosts Bruce are deleted scenes; in the released film Leonard is only seen at the restaurant, calling Ross, at the Culver battle and with Ross afterward. Should deleted-scene content stay in the record?
options: Change text to: Betty's boyfriend Leonard secretly tips off General Ross that Bruce is back, bringing the army to Culver University.
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom's Leonard Samson page sources the 'Samson agreed to have him as a guest in their home' dinner and fireside talk to The Incredible Hulk deleted scenes (TIHDS) and notes almost all of Samson's scenes were cut; Wikipedia's plot only says Samson contacts Ross.
